intelligence.enrichment: One small change in an ecosystem can lead to many other changes through connected feeding and environmental relationships. A change in one component alters the conditions or resources for connected components, which can then change their populations or life processes. The learner correctly applies this rule: One small change in an ecosystem can lead to many other changes through connected feeding and environmental relationships. A change affects only the organism that directly changes, not connected populations or conditions.
